results.reason: Connecting ideas 'logically' (not randomly), 'ongoing' emotional interactions (not occasional), support 'irrational' beliefs (not rational). ② matches.
'categorizes' which are which (not ignores), 'external' reality outside oneself (not internal), distinct from one's sense (not identical). ④ matches.
they 'continuously' put (not intermittently), 'enables' the child (not prevents), a critical 'foundation' (not obstacle). ① matches.
③ disables is wrong; original says 'enables the child to recognize.' ① logically, ② categorizes, ④ critical are all correct.
① barrier is wrong; original says 'the basis for reality testing.' ② support, ③ recognize, ④ irrational are all correct.
④ inseparable is wrong; original says 'distinct from one's sense of others.' ① ongoing, ② constant, ③ cognitive are all correct.
'recognize the difference between her ___ and the actual behavior of others' → fantasies. The passage contrasts fantasies with actual behavior.
'it requires an ability to ___ an emotional sense of self' → organize. The passage says 'organize an emotional sense of self.'
'The emotional ___ in relationships enables' → investment. The passage says 'The emotional investment in relationships.'
ongoing = continuous (지속적인). temporary(일시적) is antonym, intense(강렬한) is different axis, initial(초기의) is different.
distinct = separate (구별되는/별개의). vague(모호한), similar(유사한), connected(연결된) all wrong direction.
recognize = identify (인식하다/식별하다). ignore(무시), create(만들다), reject(거부) are all different meanings.
external ↔ internal. physical(물리적), visible(보이는), objective(객관적) are different semantic axes.
cognitive ↔ emotional. The passage itself contrasts 'purely cognitive capacity' with 'emotional sense of self.' rational/logical/analytical are types of cognitive, not opposites.
(A) support = 뒷받침하다 (abstract, supporting an ability). (B) support = 지원 (financial, material aid). ② matches (A)뒷받침하다-(B)지원.
'arrange or group things into classes or types according to shared qualities' = categorize. organize(조직), recognize(인식), connect(연결) don't match classification.
'The emotional ___ (invest)' needs a noun after article+adjective. invest → investment.
'a purely ___ (cognition) capacity' needs an adjective before noun. cognition → cognitive.
'the difference between her fantasies and ___' → the actual behavior of others. This is the direct contrast pair in the original sentence.
'Such reality testing is ___' → a critical foundation for logical thinking. Next sentence 'Without it, facts are...' confirms this is the conclusion about reality testing's role.
